title: Call bulk chromatin enrichment peaks
description: Direct Codex to validate and execute MACS3 peak calling for bulk ChIP-seq, CUT&RUN, or CUT&Tag data with explicit assay, control, peak-shape, provenance, and output-reload contracts.
questions: Which assay- and parameter-specific chromatin enrichment intervals are supported by declared treatment and, when applicable, control evidence after MACS3 output reload?
preconditions: Treatment evidence has a declared assay, genome build, coordinate semantics, biological replicate identity and immutable digest; matched input/control is available for ChIP-seq; peak shape and thresholds are declared before execution; output paths are new.
assumptions: MACS3 intervals are assay- and parameter-specific enrichment evidence. A matched ChIP input reduces but does not eliminate technical and biological confounding; no-control CUT&RUN or CUT&Tag requires separately documented specificity controls.

quality_gates.description: Block unless treatment assay, format, build, coordinates, digest, replicate identity, peak mode and threshold are declared; ChIP-seq requires an explicitly matched control in this workflow.
MACS3 must complete without fallback and produce nonempty, coordinate-valid narrowPeak or broadPeak output with finite statistical fields; narrow peaks also require reloadable summits.
Reload every output and reconcile source digests, command, detected version, assay, control decision, peak mode, genome size, duplicate policy and thresholds before interpretation.
Do not interpret a peak as direct binding, motif occupancy, enhancer activity, condition effect, or causal target regulation without appropriate replicate-level and orthogonal evidence.

limitations: This module does not perform alignment, duplicate-marking, spike-in normalization, IDR, differential binding, motif discovery, chromatin interaction calling, or causal peak-to-gene assignment. It does not install or manage dependency environments, execution infrastructure, remote job systems, or model-hosting infrastructure.

version_differences.description: MACS3 callpeak duplicate handling, broad versus narrow output and summit behavior are release- and parameter-coupled.
version_differences.required_action: Record and reload the exact peak mode, duplicate policy, thresholds and output fields before comparing projects or assays.

dependencies.name: python
dependencies.purpose: Run the generated MACS3 wrapper in an already configured scientific runtime.

concept_sources: Independent clean-room replacement for bulk chromatin peak-calling capability identified during product capability planning.

code_templates.purpose: Execute, reload, and provenance-bind bulk chromatin MACS3 peak evidence.

template_sections.purpose: Establish assay, treatment, control, build, peak shape and output semantics.
required_logic: Inspect treatment and control files, assay, library, replicate, genome build, coordinate system, source digests and peak-shape rationale before execution.
Require a matched input/control for ChIP-seq; preserve and justify no-control CUT&RUN or CUT&Tag handling.

template_sections.purpose: Call MACS3 with an explicit assay-specific parameter policy and reload outputs.
required_logic: Run MACS3 only after executable and version detection succeeds; retain exact arguments, stderr, source digests, control policy, peak mode, duplicate policy, fixed extension policy and thresholds.
Reload narrowPeak or broadPeak records, require finite statistics, and require summit output for narrow peaks without generating a fallback peak set.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare control use, narrow or broad peak mode, genome size, q threshold, duplicate policy and any fixed fragment extension from assay design before reviewing target loci or condition labels.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Reject ChIP-seq without matched control; record no-control rationale and any fixed extension for CUT&RUN or CUT&Tag and do not tune settings to expected loci.

preflight_checks: Detect MACS3 and Python versions in an existing scientific runtime.
Validate treatment/control accessibility, source digests, interval or BAM semantics, build, coordinates, assay, replicate identity, output paths and frozen parameters.
postflight_checks: Reload every peak and summit output, reconcile coordinates, finite statistics, row counts, source digests, command, versions and parameters.
Retain failed or empty output as a blocked result and limit claims to assay-specific enrichment evidence.
forbidden_actions: Do not install, update, activate, create, or manage dependency environments, execution infrastructure, remote job systems, or model-hosting infrastructure.
Do not fabricate treatment/control files, output peaks, summits, statistics, or a fallback result when MACS3 fails.
Do not call a peak direct TF binding, enhancer activity, condition effect, causal target regulation, or a replicate-level conclusion without additional evidence.
